content.text: {"what_it_is": {"claims": [{"text": "Advanced Battle Management System (ABMS, program element 0604003F) is a U.S. Air Force advanced-development program funded in the Research, Development, Test and Evaluation, Air Force account.", "citation": {"fact_id": "ada0c92baab3390a"}}, {"text": "ABMS funds architecture and systems engineering, digital infrastructure, software and applications, aerial networking, deployable systems, and long-range fires — the Department of the Air Force's primary contribution to the Combined Joint All-Domain Command and Control (CJADC2) concept, which the Air Force formally calls the DAF BATTLE NETWORK.", "citation": {"fact_id": "3e18f1761dadfe6e"}}, {"text": "The Department of the Air Force Program Executive Office for Command, Control, Communication, and Battle Management (DAF PEO C3BM) leads battle-management and command-and-control capabilities for the Air Force and directs technical integration of roughly 50 core programs spanning multiple program executive offices that collectively form the C3BM Enterprise.", "citation": {"fact_id": "3e18f1761dadfe6e"}}, {"text": "The Architecture and Systems Engineering (ASE) office is responsible for the technical integrity of the DAF BATTLE NETWORK as ABMS capabilities, the rest of the Air Force's command-and-control systems, and other services' capabilities are integrated under CJADC2.", "citation": {"fact_id": "9d25c751df1da59c"}}, {"text": "The C3BM Digital Infrastructure effort delivers secure processing, connectivity, and data management across space, airborne, and terrestrial domains, providing a multi-level security environment (unclassified to top secret) that hosts data-management tools, zero-trust applications, and AI/ML capabilities.", "citation": {"fact_id": "a4581a8a726d2c5a"}}, {"text": "The C3BM Software and Applications effort develops command-and-control applications — including Cloud-Based C2 (CBC2), which modernizes battle management by replacing four existing C2 systems with cloud-based applications enhanced by AI/ML to create a common operating picture.", "citation": {"fact_id": "77f55cb1e150985a"}}, {"text": "The Deployable Systems effort develops and delivers the Tactical Operations Center - Light (TOC-L), a light, expeditionary battle-management command-and-control system that lets C2 elements rapidly relocate, establish datalinks, connect to sensors, and operate in theater mission-partner environments.", "citation": {"fact_id": "64619299fdf58f7f"}}]}, "why_it_matters": {"claims": [{"text": "The program's total funding rises from $611,943 thousand (about $612 million) in FY2025 to $1,040,475 thousand (about $1.04 billion) requested for FY2026.", "citation": {"fact_id": "97a622de1b727cc6"}}, {"text": "That is a year-over-year increase of $428,532 thousand (about $429 million) from FY2025 to FY2026.", "citation": {"fact_id": "544966c8d5f01f9b"}}, {"text": "In FY2024 the program recorded actual spending of $455,382 thousand (about $455 million), so the FY2026 request is more than double that recent execution level.", "citation": {"fact_id": "adea4ad8a285214f"}}, {"text": "The entire FY2026 request of $1,040,475 thousand is discretionary funding; the program element carries no reconciliation (mandatory) request for FY2026.", "citation": {"fact_id": "cad522a5edc9e1fb"}}, {"text": "All of the FY2026 money flows through the single named Advanced Battle Management System (ABMS) project, funded at $1,040.475 million for the budget year.", "citation": {"fact_id": "7f9e8fcfd43e7eb1"}}, {"text": "A Fiscal Receipts feed event flagged Advanced Battle Management System (ABMS) as increasing 70% from FY2025 to FY2026.", "citation": {"fact_id": "544966c8d5f01f9b"}}]}, "players": {"claims": [{"text": "The program is run by the U.S. Air Force, with funding drawn from the Research, Development, Test and Evaluation, Air Force appropriation.", "citation": {"fact_id": "cad522a5edc9e1fb"}}, {"text": "The Department of the Air Force Program Executive Office for Command, Control, Communication, and Battle Management (DAF PEO C3BM) holds the lead role in battle management and command-and-control and exercises direct oversight of the programs funded in this portfolio.", "citation": {"fact_id": "3e18f1761dadfe6e"}}, {"text": "The DAF Integrated Fires C2 (DIFC2) effort develops beyond-line-of-sight long-range fire and control capability and connects to the future Joint Fires Network / Deployable Digital Infrastructure for the digital ingestion and processing of command orders.", "citation": {"fact_id": "e07e3beac1900b6a"}}]}, "recent_developments": {"claims": []}}
